sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-03 and 2016-12-03, cardholder C12265 experienced unauthorized activity on card C12265-K2. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $125.08 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_new_device'. The primary flagged transaction 3509359 ($125.08) was initiated through the online channel. Activity originated from a device profile (Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080) marked as New for this account. The same device profile was also observed across 253 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C12265-K2 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.
